verdict.rationale: Algolia ships InstantSearch UI libraries (vanilla JS and React) for building search interfaces. Independent users corroborate the as-you-type experience: one team says it moved to Algolia because its RAM-first index made search-as-you-type much faster than Elasticsearch or Solr, and others describe Algolia-powered search as 'fast and instant' with instant results. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of millisecond latency figures, explicit docs on per-keystroke query updates.
